description: Open a local native core/minidump with CodeLLDB, upstream LLVM lldb-dap, or GNU GDB DAP and capture bounded postmortem evidence. Use this when the failure is already recorded and no target process should execute; use debug_run_to_stop or debug_this_crash for a live reproduction instead. The tool starts only the selected local debugger adapter, never launches or resumes the crashed program, treats the dump as read-only, and returns the initial stack/locals/registers plus optional modules and disassembly.

adapter.description: Debugger adapter used for postmortem inspection. lldb-dap and gdb use their native coreFile attach semantics.

adapterPath.description: Optional explicit executable path for the selected debugger adapter; omit to use its normal discovery logic.

cwd.description: Working directory for the local debugger adapter process; this does not execute the crashed target.

dumpPath.description: Absolute or local path to the native core/minidump file to inspect.

includeDisassembly.description: Include best-effort instructions around the selected crash frame.

includeModules.description: Include loaded executable images and libraries recorded in the dump.

maxVariablesPerScope.description: Maximum variables returned per scope in the initial snapshot.

moduleCount.description: Maximum number of modules to include when includeModules is true.

program.description: Path to the matching executable image. Optional for CodeLLDB/GDB, but required when adapter=lldb-dap because LLVM coreFile loading binds the dump to its program image.

requestTimeoutMs.description: Per-request DAP timeout in milliseconds while opening and inspecting the dump.

sessionId.description: Optional DAP session ID. Omit to use the backward-compatible default session.

sourceMap.description: Optional mapping from source paths recorded in symbols to local source paths. Supported by CodeLLDB/lldb-dap; GDB currently rejects this field rather than guessing undocumented semantics.

stackLevels.description: Maximum stack frames to include in the initial postmortem snapshot.

threadId.description: Specific dump thread to inspect; omit to use the debugger-selected stopped/crashed thread.

name: debug_open_dump
title: Open Native Crash Dump
